This PR fixes an incorrect autocorrect for `Style/Semicolon` when using endless range before semicolon.

issue_context.title: Style/Semicolon:`rubocop -a` makes a breaking change
issue_context.body:
My original code is like this.  
`rubocop -a` made a breaking change and the code start to raise `ArgumentError` after that.
```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

var = 12

case var
when 10 ;
  :a
when 50... ;
  :c
end
```

## Expected behavior

I'm not sure if this is expected behavior,
but it should make my code like this I think?
```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

var = 12

case var
when 10
  :a
when (50...)
  :c
end
```

## Actual behavior
`rubocop -a` makes a breaking change and the code becomes broken.
```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

var = 12

case var
when 10
  :a
when 50...
  :c
end
```
